prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: deliberately unfinished visual direction sketch for the first desktop viewport of the HackJudge web product
Primary request: Create one flat, matte, landscape web UI concept that interprets HackJudge as a contemporary design-conference credential and program system. It should feel exploratory and intentionally unfinished, like a strong art-direction sketch, while still communicating a coherent interface.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed desktop-first webpage only, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no perspective.
Subject: A spacious live-event masthead; one dominant focal object resembling a premium student event pass/credential; an irregular project-program mosaic; a strong primary action zone; and a clearly structured semester rail. Express fun student energy with professional engineering precision. Avoid a generic SaaS card grid.
Style/medium: Flat editorial web UI design, matte print-inspired graphics, contemporary design-conference identity system, crisp geometric layout, selective rough placeholders and greeked interface lines to preserve the deliberately unfinished sketch quality.
Composition/framing: Landscape 16:9 first viewport, straight-on orthographic view. Generous breathing room. Bold asymmetric hierarchy. The premium credential/pass is the visual anchor. Use woven lanyard bands as graphic dividers or edge elements, precise registration marks and crop marks as small details, a program mosaic of varied but disciplined modules, a distinct primary action zone, and a semester rail with ordered intervals.
Lighting/mood: No lighting effects; flat, warm, energetic, intelligent, youthful, precise.
Color palette: Deep teal #0a4942, teal #0d9488, pale mint-paper #edf5f2, ink #17201e, and only small accents of warm signal yellow #f2b84b.
Materials/textures: Subtle uncoated credential stock, faint paper fiber, woven lanyard bands, dry matte ink, precise registration marks. Keep texture restrained and graphic.
Text (verbatim): "HackJudge" and "Build what matters."
Text policy: These are the ONLY legible words anywhere in the image. Render both phrases exactly. All other UI copy, labels, metadata, dates, buttons, and body text must be indistinct greeked lines or abstract marks with no readable letters, numbers, or words.
Constraints: Show a credible premium desktop web interface direction, not a poster alone. Include visible navigation structure using abstract marks, a dominant event-pass element, a project program mosaic, a strong action region, and a structured semester rail. Maintain flat matte surfaces and intentional incompleteness.
Avoid: browser chrome, device frames, perspective, photorealism, gloss, gradients, glassmorphism, 3D, shadows that imply floating cards, generic SaaS dashboards, repetitive card grids, teletext, pixel-art language, tiny readable text, lorem ipsum, extra slogans, extra logos, watermarks.
